slides.title: Real-Coded Genetic Algorithms (Cont.)

visualInspection.notes: Entire SBX density/cumulative/child formula inspected. Contracting .5(q+1)alpha^q for0≤alpha≤1; expanding .5(q+1)/alpha^(q+2) foralpha≥1; alpha is child/parent separation ratio. Printed expanding integral starts at0 instead of1, and the child formula visually places |P2−P1| as a superscript after alpha-prime; distinguish the correct multiplication relation and midpoint-preserving derivation. Equal parents require a separate branch; q domain must be explicit. Actual 1800×1013 pixels viewed alongside text.
